entry.title: [NEW] GHSA-xfq5-w38q-pc2x: Nuxt server islands render `useHeadSafe` input without sanitisation
entry.content:
Nuxt server islands render `useHeadSafe` input without sanitisation

Aliases: CVE-2026-114133

Severity: CVSS_V3: CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:L/UI:R/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:N

Affected:

  • nuxt — fixed in 4.6.2

## Impact `useHeadSafe` restricts head input to an allowlist of safe tags and attributes. For example, `bodyAttrs` is limited to `class` and `style`, event handler attributes are removed, and `<script>` tags are only kept for JSON types.
